description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) performance of various dense retrieval methods as a function of the number of queries used during inference, ranging from 1 to 10. The x-axis, labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)," is a linear scale with integer values from 1 to 10. The y-axis, labeled "MRR@10," is a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5. Six distinct methods are compared, each represented by a colored line with unique markers and styles: "DPR w/o query" (black solid line) remains constant at approximately 34.0; "DPR w/ gold" (yellow line with diamond markers) shows a steady increase from 33.0 to 35.0; "DPR w/ bottom-1" (purple line with circle markers) stays relatively flat around 34.6; "DPR w/ random" (blue line with circle markers) fluctuates slightly around 35.0; "DPR w/ curriculum" (red line with circle markers) increases from approximately 35.0 to 35.7 before stabilizing; and a green line with triangle markers, corresponding to a method not explicitly named in the legend, shows a sharp increase from 33.0 to 36.5. The plot also includes horizontal dashed lines at MRR@10 values of 35.0 and 35.5, and a solid black line at 34.0, providing reference levels for performance comparison.
